event_corrections.source: Score flat at 39074 from 2625.00 to 2630.10 (score.py); nextcount shows one spawn at 2625.733 (T, held at 2625.933, I out) and nothing more until 2630.133. The double before it was the J at 2624.93 (+1050), which is the chain's 2623.77 double. 2625.77 is a duplicate of the 2625.73 lock, with no clear. fr/g1/n19.png

The next TSD at 3167.87 scored +3600 with no B2B, which is consistent with no mini single before it. A zero-line Mini T-spin is a lock with no clear.
Score +5400 at 3348.90 (score.py), which is a B2B TSD (3600x1.5). The previous clear (3347.33) was also a +5400 B2B TSD. A plain double cannot score 5400.
nextcount spawn at 3366.200; the J hard-drops and locks at 3366.54 (score 34199->34219), before KO 3366.57; no clear. The chain has no event after 3365.4. fr/g1/n26.png

The O spawned at 4193.77 locks at 4193.93 (+26), then +900 at 4193.97 = single 300 + REN4 600. One white clear row, REN banner (fr/g1/n35.png). REN run: TSD 4190.00 +5400, single +466, single +616, quad +2850, this single. It breaks B2B, so the TSD at 4196.47 scored +3600, not 5400. That explains the -1776.

The piece spawned 4319.0 locks at 4319.27 (+34), then +1500 at 4319.30 = single 300 + REN8 1200. The '8 REN' banner and one clearing row show at 4319.4 (fr/g1/n37.png). The next piece (spawned 4319.97, O held 4320.03) is still soft-dropping at the KO 4320.63 (score +1 per frame), so it is not locked.
